description:
FILED s519b (Opus 5.5, s520, 2026-10-18) from the IO-Compress board census: an EMBEDDED `my` in the RIGHT side of a `my` declaration, inside a loop body, is not let-bound per iteration -- it is the file-level cell, so it keeps the value an earlier iteration (or an aliasing callee) wrote.  SILENT WRONG (PRE-EXISTING: same on fca3593b).

REPRO:
  sub X::n { shift; foreach (@_) { print defined $_ ? "D " : "U "; $_ = "y" } }
  for my $k (1..2) { my $l = X->n(my $t); print "$k $t\n" }
perl: U 1 y / U 2 y.   PCL: U 1 y / D 2 y.
Without the outer `my $l =` (`X->n(my $u);` as a statement) PCL agrees with perl: the statement-level lowering binds `$u` with (p-let (($u :box ...))), but `(p-my-= $l (... (p-method-call ... $t)))` reads `$t` as the file cell (p-defcell $t) -- no per-iteration binding.

REACH: IO-Compress t/compress/CompTestUtils.pm `my $lex = LexFile->new( my $name );` in loops -- LexFile::new croaks "NO!!!!" when its argument is defined, which kills the file: 002any-transparent, 005defhdr, 006zip, 010examples-zlib, 011-streamzip, 01misc, 050interop-gzip, 100generic-*, 102tied-*, 103newtied-*, ... (the s519b board join rows citing #3431).  Probe file: scratch/s519b/pr2/lex3.pl in the s519b worktree.


=== DONE (s521a, Opus 5.5, 2026-10-18) ===
Commit 9099ee33 (on MAIN-READY-32; gen v2-7284).  Pl/Parser2.pm: ONE helper `_embedded_my_let` (the let for an expression-embedded `my`, its veto, _reg_lex, _fh_scope_close) now serves the plain-statement arm AND a new pre-arm before the Variable arm; `_decl_init_embedded_my_names` = the embedded declarators of a declaration's initializer minus the own-level ones (the leading / chained `my`, #3404 / #3452's shape), minus names the statement mentions twice (#3490) and names already bound.
Probes (scratch/s521a/pr/m0a.pl, perl vs tree): for / `my ($l,$m) = (...)` / in a sub / while -- all = perl (were `D`).  Guard Pl/t/while-my-closure-01.t row 5 (FAILS on a5885afc).  corpus-diff: join.t only (`\(my $dummy = "a")` in a my-init now block-scoped); eab: lib/Storable.pm (`hole => \my $hole`).  Sweep GATE clean 18,756 +0.
IO-Compress one-file runs (final code): the LexFile files run their plan -- 002any-transparent 16/16, 005defhdr 115/115, 006zip 109/109, 01misc 164/164, 050interop-gzip 8/8, 100generic-* 800/800, 102tied-* 250/250, 103newtied-* 85/85, 105oneshot-zip-only 231/231, 108anyunc-transparent 16/16, 110encode-* 30/30, cz-08encoding 30/30, cz-14gzopen 263 of 265, 011-streamzip 137/137.  STILL stopping at "NO!!!!": 105oneshot-{gzip,zip,deflate}.t (8 of 1008) and 010examples-zlib.t (2 of 20) = #3493 (an embedded `my` whose name is an ENCLOSING lexical reuses it -- both routes).  Board rows edited (see the s521a header note in baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv).
